core_problem_solved: To provide the Hamcrest core library and a comprehensive set of matcher implementations (for collections, numbers, text, etc.) in a single, convenient 'uber-jar'.
key_features: Bundled the `assertThat` assertion mechanism with numerous matchers to write declarative, readable tests.
era_and_niche: A convenience artifact for older versions of Hamcrest, used to easily include the entire library without managing individual matcher module dependencies.
reason_for_obsolescence: This artifact is **deprecated**. The modern approach is to depend on the unified **`org.hamcrest:hamcrest`** artifact (for Hamcrest 2.x), which replaced both `-core` and `-all`, and let the build tool manage transitive dependencies. The Hamcrest style itself also competes with the more popular fluent-style assertions of AssertJ.
